title: Unicook Adjustable Porcelain Steel Heat Plate, Extends from 11.75" up to 21" L，Grill Replacement Parts, Heavy Duty Heat Shield, Burner Cover, Flame Tamer for Gas BBQ, Pack of 1
features: Adjustable grill heat plates extend from 11.75” up to 21” long, 3.75” wide, fits most outdoor gas grills such as charbroil, nexgrill and etc. If installed reversely, the length will be extended from 11.75” to 18.37” only. Please measure the width of the mounting slot on your grill to confirm compatibility before ordering
Package includes 1 single pack adjustable heat plate, upgraded Stainless Steel M5 bolts and wing nuts. Easy to install, replaces heat tents for side-to-side and front-to-back burners
Prevents flare-ups and protects burners to prolong life, prevents direct exposure to flame and distributes heat evenly
Thickness of porcelain steel is 1.2mm, heavy duty porcelain-coated steel construction; Thicker is better and last longer!
Stainless Steel version is also available, click the "UNICOOK" button (top middle of the page) to get more details about the S/S version
